description: Exploratory probe of the q-NS surreal-bridge grade trichotomy (QOU/FluidDynamics/surreal_enstrophy_finite_modes.lean): measures the realized enstrophy scaling exponent α in Ω(1+ε) ~ ε^(−α) on the ladder ε=1e-1..1e-6, with the Lean convention [k]_q = (q^k−1)/(q−1) and the corpus cascade cutoff N_eff = (3/4)ln Re/ln q (Re=1e4). Model A: sustained Kolmogorov a_k=k^(-5/3) (turbulent forcing). Model B: Gevrey a_k=exp(-k/2) (fixed smooth data). Bins: α≈0 grade-0 regular; α≈1 saturated; 0<α<1 intermediate; α>1 exceeds the Lean-proved grade-1 cap, falsifying the dissipation closure for that spectrum. Decides the regime of the MODELED spectrum only — not the true q-NS flow (open). Precision tier: float64+fsum (scaling fit), not a 50-dps canonical derivation.
